levels.surface: أبا عبد الله الصادق جعفر بن محمد

notes: The first name in the text is the compiler himself (al-Saduq); he is the head the tool adds, so the written route starts at ماجيلويه (ruling 1)
Bare «أبيه» with no name is a relation link each time (rule 7); the footnote marks (1), (2) and the blessing are left out
The Imam is named in the words after the chain («سمعت أبا عبد الله ... يقول»), so he is the last link as imam_in_text (ruling 2)
